about: Spain's 2026 restrictions for trucks over 7.5 t on the roads the DGT's yearly resolution lists (apartado B.1.1, anexo II), generated from the BOE's consolidated text by tools/tables/es_bans.py; tools/tables/check_bans.py regenerates it and compares. Each holds only on its road section and direction, so a trip is said to may run into it. The DGT's resolution doesn't cover Catalonia and the Basque Country, which set their own.
